stories.title: Près de 8,3 millions de réfugiés et déplacés menacés par le recul de l'aide internationale, alerte le HCR

en.title: Nearly 8.3 million refugees and displaced persons threatened by decline in international aid, warns UNHCR
en.summary: The UN refugee agency reports that funding cuts have reduced available resources from 5.2 billion to 3.9 billion dollars between 2024 and 2025, putting support organizations at a breaking point and endangering 8.3 million people from receiving assistance this year.

stories.title: Projet d'attaque en Angleterre: "clairement un acteur étranger" affirme Marco Rubio

en.title: Attack plot in England: "clearly a foreign actor" says Marco Rubio
en.summary: Five British suspects were arrested near an American military base in England and subsequently released on bail. Donald Trump stated he would not have released them.

stories.title: Erstmals können Menschen in der Schweiz selbstfahrende Taxis nutzen. Doch kurz vor dem Projektstart ereignet sich der erste Unfall

en.title: For the first time, people in Switzerland can use self-driving taxis. But shortly before the project launch, the first accident occurs
en.summary: Autonomous vehicles are set to supplement Swiss rail services, though the project manager does not expect them to dominate the market as they have in China and America.

stories.title: AMD rachète la start-up d'intelligence artificielle fondée par Fei-Fei Li pour 8,2 milliards de dollars

en.title: AMD acquires artificial intelligence start-up founded by Fei-Fei Li for 8.2 billion dollars
en.summary: AMD announced the acquisition of World Labs, an AI company founded by researcher Fei-Fei Li, for 8.2 billion dollars. The startup develops AI programs capable of generating three-dimensional virtual worlds for robot training.

stories.title: En direct, Moyen-Orient – Donald Trump dit n'avoir pas proposé de levée de sanctions à l'Iran

en.title: In brief, Middle East – Donald Trump says he did not propose lifting sanctions on Iran
en.summary: The US president denied reports that he offered Iran sanctions relief or unfrozen funds. Trump stated he expects discussions with Iran to resume within the following week.

stories.title: Un cancer sur huit est d'origine infectieuse et certains sont évitables, selon une nouvelle étude

en.title: One in eight cancers is caused by infection and some are preventable, according to new study
en.summary: A WHO cancer research agency estimates that approximately 2.3 million new global cancer cases annually result from preventable infections. The finding reveals infections as a significant cancer cause worldwide.

stories.title: L'Iran attend une nouvelle réponse de Washington, Donald Trump nie toute concession

en.title: Iran awaits new response from Washington, Donald Trump denies any concession
en.summary: Tehran is waiting for a US response to its latest proposal regarding a ceasefire and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Trump confirms talks are occurring but denies offering Iran sanctions relief.

stories.title: Environ un cancer sur huit dans le monde serait lié à des infections, selon une étude du Centre international de recherche sur le cancer

en.title: Approximately one in eight cancers worldwide are linked to infections, according to an International Agency for Research on Cancer study
en.summary: Epidemiologists calculated cancer cases attributable to viruses, bacteria, and parasites, finding about 2.3 million annual cases preventable. East Asia and Africa are particularly affected by infection-related cancers.

stories.title: Ce que l’on sait du projet d’attaque présumé contre une base militaire en Angleterre

en.title: What is known about the alleged plot to attack a military base in England
en.summary: Five British people arrested near a U.S.-used military base in England on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act were released on bail. Counterterrorism police are investigating multiple leads, including possible involvement by a foreign state, while Iran denies involvement.

stories.title: Nvidia rachète ses propres actions pour un montant record de 150 milliards de dollars

en.title: Nvidia buys back its own shares for a record amount of 150 billion dollars
en.summary: Nvidia's board of directors authorized a record 150 billion dollar share buyback program. The American semiconductor giant announced this decision on Monday.

stories.title: Selbstfahrende Autos – Ab jetzt ist das erste Robotaxi der Schweiz im Einsatz

en.title: Self-driving cars – Switzerland's first robotaxi is now in operation
en.summary: Switzerland's first robotaxi has begun operating in the Furttal region of Zurich canton, where passengers can now book rides through the service.

stories.title: Les suspects du projet d'attentat contre la base militaire de Fairford libérés sous caution

en.title: Suspects in alleged attack plot against Fairford military base released on bail
en.summary: Five men suspected of preparing an explosive attack in England were released on bail after interrogation. They were arrested near a U.S. air base used for operations against Iran; Tehran denies involvement.

stories.title: So viel Luftverteidigung braucht die Schweiz – und so viel kostet es

en.title: How much air defense Switzerland needs – and what it costs
en.summary: The Swiss government must decide whether to acquire a second air defense system with greater range. Effective defense against ballistic missiles and hypersonic weapons requires coordination with military partners.

stories.title: Staus an den Tankstellen: Italiens Energiekonzerne deckeln die Spritpreise

en.title: Queues at petrol stations: Italy's energy companies cap fuel prices
en.summary: Italian energy companies have imposed price caps on fuel, prompting government approval while companies seek to avoid taxes on windfall profits. The measure has not satisfied all parties involved.

stories.title: DATENANALYSE - 25 Jahre nach dem Grounding: Die Swiss fliegt in deutlich weniger Länder als die Swissair

en.title: Data analysis - 25 years after the grounding: Swiss flies to significantly fewer countries than Swissair
en.summary: A comparison of flight schedules shows that Zurich had more destinations accessible via Swissair in 2001 than via Swiss in 2026, particularly with long-haul routes to Africa being drastically reduced.

stories.title: Cottbus verliert seinen grössten Wirtschaftszweig – und gilt dennoch als «dynamischste Region Deutschlands»

en.title: Cottbus loses its largest economic sector – yet is considered "Germany's most dynamic region"
en.summary: The former East German energy city is transitioning away from coal power through billions in state subsidies, aiming to become green and modern. Many Cottbus residents question their views on this future direction.

stories.title: Die letzten amerikanischen Soldaten ziehen aus dem Irak ab – sie hinterlassen Leid, Hass und Sehnsucht

en.title: The last American soldiers withdraw from Iraq – leaving behind suffering, hatred and longing
en.summary: As US troops withdraw from Iraq, residents in Falluja express concerns about Iranian influence. Most Iraqis, however, wish to have nothing more to do with Americans two decades after the invasion.
